selection.objective: Mean development full-rollout completion across four subclasses, with each clearing size no more than2 lost successes against the shared parent. Initialization is eligible; test opens only after selection freezes.

scope: New small sampling stage from the adopted889 shared Q and Adam. Same encoder, directed_sum, coordinate cap13, unreachable19, Huber, complete-candidate soft-rank and physical actions. Both arms share fresh seeds, total decision budget and generated training roots; only goal-class sampling differs. Full stars along one exact teacher route per query; no oracle or goal-cell filtering in inference. Whole source roots are disjoint across this stage's train/development/test and exclude clear1000. Descendant-state overlap and older model exposure are not claimed absent. No automatic adoption or expansion.
